Owner approved `research/apps-list-mockups.html` v1 ("that mock-up looks fine to me") and said: "Make sure that the apps have their icons in the final version." Owner also said UI skeletons/placeholders are the way to fix layout-shift problems (CLS). ## Most important behaviour The Apps tab (the existing `AppPriorityScreen`) shows each app with its real icon, can be filtered by category (chips with counts) and by a search field, is alphabetical with sticky letter headers, and has a draggable A-Z rail on the right (letters present in the filtered list only, `#` for digits/symbols, letter bubble while held, haptic tick). While loading it shows row-shaped skeletons that hold the loaded slots (same width/height, fixed icon box); no layout shift when data or icons arrive; cached rows stay visible through discovery. Everything else on the screen (priority, lock, queue preference, channel offsets, expanded row, the gear) keeps working exactly as today. ## Invariants - Sort is alphabetical (case-insensitive, locale-aware) with a stable tiebreak by package; the "has notifications" grouping becomes a chip, not a sort partition (default I took: owner may overrule). - The rail only lists letters that exist in the currently filtered list; tapping/dragging a letter jumps to its first row; with the filter changed the rail updates. - One category chip at a time (All clears it). Category = the category Farhan already resolves for the app (`NotificationCategory` via the existing resolver); counts are per category in the full list. - Icons load off the main thread, cached and size-limited; fixed 40 dp icon box reserved for every row (also while loading and when the drawable is missing: letter tile fallback). No per-row work on Main beyond drawing. - Filter and scroll position survive expanding a row; the filter resets when leaving the screen. - No new stored settings. No change to preference keys or SettingsCatalog. ## Priority concerns legibility 7, architecture 7, performance (scroll must not jank: no icon decoding on Main, `contentType`/keys kept), accessibility (rail has a text alternative, chips have selected state, skeleton is one loading status). Lower: shimmer (optional; off by default under reduced motion), copy polish. ## Evidence required 1. Pure JVM tests for: filtering by category and search, the alphabetical sort with sections and `#` bucket, rail letters from a filtered list, jump index computation, chip counts. Each with why/catches. Targeted tests only (pilot). 2. A small Compose-free `AppIconLoader` port with a fake and a test (cache hit, missing drawable -> fallback, cancellation). 3. Boat: targeted unit tests, `:app:compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin`, `:app:assembleDebug` (keep using Boat until it refuses a run; credit remains). 4. internal val appRailWidth = 32.dp

@Composable
internal fun AppAlphabetRail(
    letters: List<String>,
    onJump: (String) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    if (letters.isEmpty()) return
    val haptics = LocalHapticFeedback.current
    val jump by rememberUpdatedState(onJump)
    var heldLetter by remember(letters) { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

    Box(modifier = modifier.fillMaxHeight().width(appRailWidth)) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxHeight().fillMaxWidth().pointerInput(letters, haptics) {
                awaitEachGesture {
                    val down = awaitFirstDown()
                    down.consume()
                    fun choose(y: Float) {
                        if (size.height <= 0) return
                        val index = (y / size.height * letters.size).toInt().coerceIn(letters.indices)
                        val letter = letters[index]
                        if (letter != heldLetter) {
                            heldLetter = letter
                            jump(letter)
                            haptics.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.TextHandleMove)
                        }
                    }
                    try {
                        choose(down.position.y)
                        do {
                            val change = awaitPointerEvent().changes.firstOrNull { it.id == down.id }
                            if (change == null || !change.pressed || change.isConsumed) break
                            choose(change.position.y)
                            change.consume()
                        } while (true)
                    } finally {
                        heldLetter = null
                    }
                }
            },
        ) {
            letters.forEach { letter ->
                val action = stringResource(R.string.app_list_jump_to, letter)
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth().clearAndSetSemantics {
                        contentDescription = action
                        onClick {
                            jump(letter)
                            true
                        }
                    },
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = letter,
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        lineHeight = 11.sp,
                        fontWeight = if (letter == heldLetter) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal,
                        color = if (letter == heldLetter) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                        else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        softWrap = false,
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        heldLetter?.let { letter ->
            Surface(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterStart).offset(x = (-62).dp)
                    .requiredSize(56.dp).clearAndSetSemantics {},
                shape = CircleShape,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer,
                contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
            ) {
                Box(contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    Text(letter, style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

internal val appRailWidth = 32.dp

@Composable
internal fun AppAlphabetRail(
    letters: List<String>,
    onJump: (String) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    if (letters.isEmpty()) return
    val haptics = LocalHapticFeedback.current
    val jump by rememberUpdatedState(onJump)
    var heldLetter by remember(letters) { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

    Box(modifier = modifier.fillMaxHeight().width(appRailWidth)) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxHeight().fillMaxWidth().pointerInput(letters, haptics) {
                awaitEachGesture {
                    val down = awaitFirstDown()
                    down.consume()
                    fun choose(y: Float) {
                        if (size.height <= 0) return
                        val index = (y / size.height * letters.size).toInt().coerceIn(letters.indices)
                        val letter = letters[index]
                        if (letter != heldLetter) {
                            heldLetter = letter
                            jump(letter)
                            haptics.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.TextHandleMove)
                        }
                    }
                    try {
                        choose(down.position.y)
                        do {
                            val change = awaitPointerEvent().changes.firstOrNull { it.id == down.id }
                            if (change == null || !change.pressed || change.isConsumed) break
                            choose(change.position.y)
                            change.consume()
                        } while (true)
                    } finally {
                        heldLetter = null
                    }
                }
            },
        ) {
            letters.forEach { letter ->
                val action = stringResource(R.string.app_list_jump_to, letter)
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth().clearAndSetSemantics {
                        contentDescription = action
                        onClick {
                            jump(letter)
                            true
                        }
                    },
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = letter,
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        lineHeight = 11.sp,
                        fontWeight = if (letter == heldLetter) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal,
                        color = if (letter == heldLetter) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                        else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        softWrap = false,
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        heldLetter?.let { letter ->
            Surface(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterStart).offset(x = (-62).dp)
                    .requiredSize(56.dp).clearAndSetSemantics {},
                shape = CircleShape,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer,
                contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
            ) {
                Box(contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    Text(letter, style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

- Mock-up: `research/apps-list-mockups.html` (CSS and markup; identical copy in both repos).
